descripcion: Furniture for offices, receptions and waiting rooms, and for supermarkets and shops, with their machines and typical obstacles.

mesa_despacho.descripcion: Office desk with a computer and papers; the drawer holds things. The chair sits in front.
mesa_despacho.imagen: Footprint of “Office desk”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Md”.

mesa_ele.descripcion: Office desk with a wing turning at a right angle: it wraps round whoever sits at it.
mesa_ele.imagen: Footprint of “L-shaped desk”: an L shape, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

silla_giratoria.descripcion: Swivel chair with castors and arms. Bump into it and it rolls and turns.
silla_giratoria.imagen: Footprint of “Office chair”: a circle, 0.64 by 0.64 metres, marked with the letters “Sg”.

silla_confidente.descripcion: Fixed four-legged chair for visitors to the office.
silla_confidente.imagen: Footprint of “Visitor chair”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

mesa_reuniones.descripcion: Large oval boardroom table with chairs round it. No corners: follow the edge to go round.
mesa_reuniones.imagen: Footprint of “Meeting table”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 2.40 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

archivador.descripcion: Metal filing cabinet with drawers. An open drawer sticks out half a metre at knee or chest height.
archivador.imagen: Footprint of “Filing cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.47 by 0.62 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

armario_oficina.descripcion: Tall two-door metal cupboard for folders.
armario_oficina.imagen: Footprint of “Office cupboard”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ao”.

estanteria_oficina.imagen: Footprint of “Office shelving”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Eo”.

papelera.descripcion: Mesh bin beside the desk. Light: it tips over if kicked.
papelera.imagen: Footprint of “Waste bin”: a circle, 0.28 by 0.28 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

perchero.descripcion: Metal pole with arms at the top for coats.
perchero.imagen: Footprint of “Coat stand”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

mampara.descripcion: Dividing panel between workstations: thin, shoulder high and covered in fabric.
mampara.imagen: Footprint of “Office partition”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.06 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

pizarra_caballete.descripcion: Board with a paper pad on a tripod. The legs spread wider at the floor than the board.
pizarra_caballete.imagen: Footprint of “Flipchart”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

mostrador_recepcion.descripcion: Straight, tall counter at chest height, with a person behind it.
mostrador_recepcion.imagen: Footprint of “Reception desk”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

mostrador_curvo.descripcion: Arc-shaped counter bulging towards whoever arrives. Follow it with your hand: no corners.
mostrador_curvo.imagen: Footprint of “Curved reception desk”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 2.80 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

sillas_espera.descripcion: Row of seats joined on a beam, against the wall. They do not move.
sillas_espera.imagen: Footprint of “Row of waiting room seats”: a rectangle, 1.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

mesita.descripcion: Low square table with magazines, in the middle of the waiting room. At knee height.
mesita.imagen: Footprint of “Magazine table”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

planta.descripcion: Large planter with a tall plant. The leaves brush you first.
planta.imagen: Footprint of “Indoor plant”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Pl”.

dispensador_turno.descripcion: Post with a machine that gives you a paper slip with your queue number.
dispensador_turno.imagen: Footprint of “Queue ticket dispenser”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Dt”.

postes_cinta.descripcion: Two posts joined by a belt at waist height, to guide the queue. The cane passes under the belt.
postes_cinta.imagen: Footprint of “Queue barrier posts”: two posts joined by a thin belt, 2.00 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

fotocopiadora.descripcion: Large photocopier at chest height. When copying it hums from side to side.
fotocopiadora.imagen: Footprint of “Photocopier”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Fo”.

maquina_cafe.descripcion: Coin-operated coffee machine, as tall as a cupboard. It hums all the time and grinds and pours when you order.
maquina_cafe.imagen: Footprint of “Coffee machine”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

maquina_expendedora.descripcion: Drinks and snacks machine with a glass front. It hums constantly: you hear it from far off.
maquina_expendedora.imagen: Footprint of “Vending machine”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

dispensador_agua.descripcion: Narrow column with a water bottle on top. When you pour, the bottle goes glug, glug.
dispensador_agua.imagen: Footprint of “Water cooler”: a rectangle, 0.33 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Da”.

cajero.descripcion: Cash machine, wall-mounted or free-standing: screen and keypad at chest height. The buttons beep.
cajero.imagen: Footprint of “Cash machine”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

gondola.descripcion: Long double-sided shelving full of goods. Two of them make an aisle: follow it with your hand.
gondola.imagen: Footprint of “Supermarket shelving”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Go”.

gondola_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Supermarket wall shelving”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

caja_registradora.descripcion: Supermarket checkout: the long belt where you put your shopping and, at the end, the cashier's station. You pass along the free side.
caja_registradora.imagen: Footprint of “Checkout with belt”: an L shape: the long belt on one side and the cashier's station at the back, 1.20 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

caja_autopago.descripcion: Station to pay by yourself: touch screen, scanner and a bagging scale.
caja_autopago.imagen: Footprint of “Self-checkout”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

carritos.descripcion: Row of shopping trolleys nested into each other. Wire metal: it rattles when touched.
carritos.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked trolleys”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

carrito_suelto.descripcion: A shopping trolley abandoned in the middle of the aisle. It rolls if pushed.
carrito_suelto.imagen: Footprint of “Stray trolley”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

cestas.descripcion: Stack of plastic baskets by the entrance.
cestas.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked baskets”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.32 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

arcon_congelados.descripcion: Long, low chest with sliding glass lids. It hums and cold comes off it.
arcon_congelados.imagen: Footprint of “Chest freezer”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

palet.descripcion: Wooden pallet stacked with boxes, left in the aisle for restocking. An obstacle that is not usually there.
palet.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet of goods”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

senal_suelo_mojado.descripcion: Plastic A-frame warning of a wet floor. Small and light: it falls over with a hollow clack.
senal_suelo_mojado.imagen: Footprint of “Wet floor sign”: a small triangle, 0.30 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ss”.

mostrador_vitrina.descripcion: Shop counter with a glass display case at the front: it sounds like glass when touched.
mostrador_vitrina.imagen: Footprint of “Display counter”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mv”.

expositor_giratorio.descripcion: Round display stand that spins, with postcards or glasses. Push it and it turns.
expositor_giratorio.imagen: Footprint of “Rotating display stand”: an octagon, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Eg”.

perchero_ropa.descripcion: Wheeled rail full of hanging clothes. Soft to touch; the cane passes beneath the clothes.
perchero_ropa.imagen: Footprint of “Clothes rail”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

perchero_circular.descripcion: Round rack loaded with clothes, in the middle of the shop.
perchero_circular.imagen: Footprint of “Circular clothes rack”: a circle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

probador.descripcion: Cubicle with three thin walls and a curtain at the front. Draw the curtain back to go in.
probador.imagen: Footprint of “Fitting room”: a thin-walled U, open at the front where the curtain hangs, 1.10 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

maniqui.descripcion: Mannequin standing on a round base. The size of a person, but it does not answer.
maniqui.imagen: Footprint of “Mannequin”: an oval, 0.45 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

banco_tienda.descripcion: Padded backless bench to sit on while trying shoes or waiting.
banco_tienda.imagen: Footprint of “Bench”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

cartel_caballete.descripcion: Two-sided folding sign standing in front of the shop door.
cartel_caballete.imagen: Footprint of “A-board”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

puerta_giratoria.descripcion: Revolving door: a round glass drum with turning leaves. As an obstacle it is a cylinder; you must time your step to enter.
puerta_giratoria.imagen: Footprint of “Revolving door”: a circle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pg”.

torno.descripcion: Tripod turnstile: a narrow metal body with an arm barring the way until it gives.
torno.imagen: Footprint of “Entry turnstile”: an L shape, 0.80 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “To”.

arco_seguridad.descripcion: Two tall, thin panels either side of the shop door. You walk between them.
arco_seguridad.aviso: Security gates: you pass between two panels.
arco_seguridad.imagen: Footprint of “Security gates”: two thin panels joined by a strip on the floor, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

columna.descripcion: Round column in the middle of the room. Hard; no warning until touched.
columna.imagen: Footprint of “Column”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

extintor.descripcion: Fire extinguisher hung on the wall one metre up. The cane passes under it.
extintor.imagen: Footprint of “Wall fire extinguisher”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ex”.

felpudo_entrada.descripcion: Wide mat just inside the door. You feel it underfoot: you have just come in.
felpudo_entrada.imagen: Footprint of “Entrance mat”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Fe”.

mesa_bench.descripcion: Long double desk where people work in two rows, face to face, divided by a low screen down the middle. It only has legs at the ends: the cane slides underneath as far as the chairs on the other side.
mesa_bench.imagen: Footprint of “Bench desking”: a long double desktop with a low screen running down the middle, 2.80 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

mesa_elevable.descripcion: Office desk on two motorised columns: one button raises it to chest height for working standing up and another lowers it. Its height changes from one moment to the next and it hums as it moves.
mesa_elevable.imagen: Footprint of “Sit-stand desk”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

cubiculo.descripcion: Workstation enclosed by three fabric panels at shoulder height, open at the front. Inside, an L-shaped desk and a chair; outside, a corridor between identical cubicles that you follow by hand.
cubiculo.imagen: Footprint of “Office cubicle”: a U open at the front, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cu”.

mampara_vidrio.descripcion: Floor-to-ceiling glass wall closing off an office or meeting room, with aluminium frames and a glass door. You can walk into it without noticing; the cane gives a sharp, high knock.
mampara_vidrio.imagen: Footprint of “Glass office partition”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Mv”.

mesa_abatible_formacion.descripcion: Narrow tables on castors whose tops flip upright so they nest into each other. Open, they form rows in the room; folded, a tall line against the wall.
mesa_abatible_formacion.imagen: Footprint of “Flip-top training tables”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

rack_servidores.descripcion: Tall, deep metal cabinet with a mesh door, full of equipment with small lights. Its fans roar non-stop and hot air comes out of the back: you hear it from the corridor.
rack_servidores.imagen: Footprint of “Server rack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rs”.

split_aire.descripcion: Long unit mounted high on the wall, above head height. You cannot touch it, but when on it blows cold air downwards and hums: it marks that wall.
split_aire.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted air conditioner”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.25 metres, hanging 2.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sa”.

cocina_office.descripcion: Compact kitchen unit: sink, a small fridge underneath and a wall cupboard above with the microwave. There is always someone with a coffee around it; the floor by the sink may be wet.
cocina_office.imagen: Footprint of “Office kitchenette”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.62 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

destructora_papel.descripcion: Tall bin with a head on top and a slot where papers go in. Feed one in and it starts with a grinding roar of blades and stops by itself.
destructora_papel.imagen: Footprint of “Paper shredder”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Dp”.

verificador_precios.descripcion: Small screen with a barcode reader fixed to a column or the end of an aisle, at chest height. Pass a product under it and it beeps and says or shows the price.
verificador_precios.imagen: Footprint of “Price checker”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Vp”.

mural_refrigerado.descripcion: Refrigerated shelving with no doors against the wall, holding dairy or cut fruit. A curtain of cold air falls down the front; you feel it on your face and it hums all the time.
mural_refrigerado.imagen: Footprint of “Open multideck chiller”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

armario_refrigerado.descripcion: Tall drinks or frozen-food fridge with glass doors opening into the aisle. The glass is cold and misted; it hums and the door closes by itself.
armario_refrigerado.imagen: Footprint of “Glass-door upright fridge”: a rectangle, 1.30 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

mesa_degustacion.descripcion: Small skirted table with a person behind it offering samples, set up in the middle of the aisle for a few days. It smells of food and the promoter talks to passers-by.
mesa_degustacion.imagen: Footprint of “Promotional tasting stand”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Md”.

escalera_reposicion.descripcion: Metal ladder with several steps, a platform at the top and handrails, on castors. It rolls if pushed empty; when someone climbs on, it brakes and stays put.
escalera_reposicion.imagen: Footprint of “Rolling stock ladder”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.70 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

prensa_carton.descripcion: Cupboard-sized machine in the back room, with a barred door where the cardboard goes in. Running, the plate comes down with a hydraulic whine and a dull thud.
prensa_carton.imagen: Footprint of “Cardboard baler”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

exprimidora_naranjas.descripcion: Machine on a cabinet, taller than a person, with a basket of oranges on top and a plastic dome. Press it and the oranges roll down, the blades split them and the juice drips into the bottle.
exprimidora_naranjas.imagen: Footprint of “Self-service orange juicer”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

maquina_reciclaje_envases.descripcion: Large machine set into the wall by the entrance, with a round hole at chest height where cans and bottles go in. A belt pulls them in, crushes them with a crunch and beeps as it gives the voucher.
maquina_reciclaje_envases.imagen: Footprint of “Reverse vending machine”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

reja_tijera.descripcion: Grille of metal bars that folds like an accordion to one side of the shop entrance. Folded it is a narrow bundle by the frame; drawn across, it blocks the way and clangs like iron.
reja_tijera.imagen: Footprint of “Folding security grille”: a thin zigzag of crossed bars, 2.00 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Rt”.
